Lessons.Title: Solving Systems with Cramer's Rule
ExplanationParagraphs: Determinants of square matrices are scalars computed by signed expansion.
Interchanging rows changes determinant sign; scaling one row scales determinant.
For det(A)=0 there is no unique solution; classify using elimination.
Model quantities with two- or three-variable equations and solve using determinants.
Independent Cool-down: demonstrate a valid example of the section's central operation and check exact answer.
